description: This file defines functions and logic for managing reply streams in a Microsoft Teams bot extension, including handling informative status texts, stream creation, partial reply handling, payload preparation, and finalization.

methods.name: pickInformativeStatusText
methods.description: Selects an informative status text at random from a predefined list.

methods.name: createTeamsReplyStreamController
methods.description: Creates and returns a reply stream controller object for handling Teams message streaming, including methods for starting reply, handling partial replies, preparing payloads, finalizing, and checking stream existence.
